summary: Phase 6 (video-on-listings + shoppable Stories) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed via /app/backend/tests/test_stories_phase6.py — verified-only gate returns 401 unauth / 403 unverified on POST /api/upload/video, GET /api/stories, and GET /api/files/{path}; upload validation rejects non-video ext (400 'Only MP4/MOV/WEBM/M4V') and >120MB (400); small MP4 accepted, path returned, GET /api/files/{path} serves with video/* content-type. Listing lifecycle: create+publish live listing with video -> has_video=true, appears in GET /api/listings AND GET /api/listings?has_video=true; excluded when listing has no video; GET /api/stories auto-generates a story with non-null listing_id, seller PUBLIC layer only (display_handle+verified_badge, NO email/phone/real-name/credential leak); every returned story resolves to a live listing that still has a video; removing the video (via PUT with publish=True, video=null) deactivates the story (removed from GET /stories); re-adding the video reactivates it. No-video listing creates NO story and is absent from has_video=true. OpenAPI has zero live-streaming surface (no rtmp/hls/livestream/websocket/ws). Frontend (real preview URL, pass.officer seller): /marketplace shows Featured Stories reel (data-testid=featured-stories) with 3 story-card-{listing_id} cards; clicking opens story-viewer with story-video + story-overlay + story-shop-btn; clicking 'View & Buy' navigates to /listing/{listing_id} (verified matches card's listing_id). detail-video element present on listing page. chip-video is ACTIVE (not inert), toggles 'chip active' class, triggers GET /api/listings?has_video=true (network verified) and grid renders exactly the 3 has-video listings — no NoVideo bleed. /sell wizard: video-add + video-input + video-preview all functional — set_input_files on hidden video-input triggered preview + successful publish which navigated straight to /listing/{new_id}; that new listing subsequently appeared in Has-video feed and Featured Stories reel. NOTE: video playback readyState=0 / MediaError code 4 on all uploaded videos because the seed and test uploads are random-bytes .mp4 (called out in the review request itself — 'a random-bytes .mp4 will pass the API but won\'t actually play'). The <video src> is set to a same-origin /api/files/... URL and the cookie-authed GET returns bytes with video/mp4 content-type — the plumbing is correct; only the bytes are non-decodable. This is NOT a bug in Phase 6 code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1715 lines (grew ~70 lines with Phase 6). Same split-into-routers/ recommendation as iter_7 — auth, storage, marketplace, offers, transactions, admin, payments, stories all still in one module. Phase 7 (boosts/Stripe) and Phase 8 (messaging) will make this worse; splitting before then is strongly recommended.

sync_story() uses `await db.stories.count_documents({})` as the `order` field for new stories. This is a race condition under concurrent listing publishes (two concurrent creates -> same order value). Non-critical for MVP but flag it before scaling.

sync_story() deactivates by setting active=False but never deletes. If a listing is deleted (there is no DELETE listing endpoint yet, but planned) the orphaned story doc will linger. Also GET /stories filters {active: True} + re-checks the listing is live+has_video — so hard state divergence is masked, but it's technical debt.
GET /stories loops through active stories and does a per-story `find_one` on listings — N+1 query. Fine for tens of stories, will need a $lookup or batched load beyond that.

StoryViewer.jsx: onClick on the outer .story-modal (root div) triggers onClose. .story-stage stopPropagation prevents click-through inside the modal, but the <video controls> native seeker fullscreen click can accidentally close if you tap outside the stage. Consider closing only via the explicit story-close button, not backdrop.

Video element on Marketplace/story cards uses `s.photo ? fileUrl(s.photo)` for the thumbnail — the photo URL is a /api/files/... path that requires cookie auth. Works because sends the session cookie same-origin, but if CDN caching is introduced later this needs a signed URL.

No range-request (Accept-Ranges: bytes) support on GET /api/files/{path} — full-file serving means seeking a 100MB video always downloads the whole thing before it plays. Acceptable for MVP as noted in the request, but must be addressed before videos regularly exceed a few MB.
There is no upper bound on the number of stories returned (limit=200) or per-seller cap. A seller with 200+ live video listings would dominate the reel.

ListingBody accepts `video: Optional[str]` with no validation that the string is actually a stored video path owned by the user. A caller could set video to any /api/files/... path (their own OR someone else's photo path) and it would be stored. Frontend guards this but the API doesn't.

Regression suites: test_first_unit.py (P1), test_verification_phase2.py (P2), test_profiles_phase3.py (P3), test_marketplace_phase4.py (P4), test_payments_phase5.py (P5), test_stories_phase6.py (P6). server.py is now ~1715 lines — split before Phase 7.
